    - [x] Inventory: every proof layer, with what it checks, its owner and how often it caught something the others missed, measured from 30 days of runs (designing/docs/proof-layers-4889.md). check: test platform/tests/4889-inventory.bats
    - [ ] A card's proof path is exactly: one test run, one code review, one architecture and quality review, prove in prod, and Jeff's go. Nothing else runs between push and land. check: test platform/tests/4889-one-path.bats
    - [ ] One test run: a round's tests run once, not once in the pair and again in cicd. check: test platform/tests/4889-one-test-run.bats
    - [ ] One code review: it reads the card's diff for correctness and tests, on every diff, and never reads or counts AC boxes. Negative proof: a planted bug in a diff is flagged, and a diff whose only gap is an unticked AC is not. check: test platform/tests/4889-code-review.bats
    - [ ] One architecture and quality review: it reads the diff for boundaries, duplication, one path, hollow checks, error paths and dead code, on every diff, fix cards included. Negative proof: a planted duplicate path or hollow check is flagged, and an unticked AC alone is not. check: test platform/tests/4889-arch-quality-review.bats
    - [ ] Prove in prod: every AC names one check, borg-prove runs each against prod after the land, and a red reopens the card. The whole newest run of a test decides: any failed case reads Not met, any skipped case reads unmeasured. A card with no checks fails. Negative proofs for each. check: test platform/tests/4889-prove-in-prod.bats
    - [ ] Each step calls the existing skill: `/code-review` for the code review, `/gate-arch` and `/gate-quality` for the architecture and quality review, borg-prove for prove in prod. No copies and no new names; the old copies (the demo's own gate and review prompts) are deleted in this land. check: test platform/tests/4889-existing-skills.bats
    - [ ] The code review also checks that each AC's check really tests that AC: a check that does not exercise what its AC says is a finding. Negative proof: an AC whose check names an unrelated test is flagged. check: test platform/tests/4889-review-checks-the-checks.bats
    - [ ] No two AC point to the same check file; each AC's check tests that AC alone. Negative proof: a card with two AC on one check file fails. check: test platform/tests/4889-one-check-file-per-ac.bats
    - [ ] After land: the next card needs one cicd run, measured. check: test platform/tests/4889-one-cicd-run.bats
